data.text:
Severe humanitarian conditions on ships trapped in the Strait of Hormuz

The Wall Street Journal reported:
🔹“Shamim Saber,” a navigator of a Chinese oil tanker, contacted the Iranian Navy to find a way out of this conflict and was told that “the situation in the area is very dangerous and it is a red zone.

🔹His and his crew’s food supplies are running out, while American warships are trying to escort two U.S.-flagged ships through Iranian missile fire, and the emergency maritime contact channel is full of requests from sailors stranded at sea.

🔹The Persian Gulf has become a floating prison for low-paid workers. Their situation is a consequence of the U.S. aggression against Iran. These sailors are mostly from countries like Syria, the Philippines, and Indonesia, caught in the crossfire with dwindling initial supplies. At least 10 sailors have died since the crisis began.

🔹Experts predict that in the coming weeks, the number of crew abandoned by bankrupt owners will increase, and the worsening medical conditions on ships facing shortages of medicine and illness will become more severe.

🔹An Indian sailor told the Wall Street Journal that his ship has run out of food and fresh water, and two crew members are in critical condition. A Russian sailor also said they only have rice and water and have run out of his blood pressure medication.

🚨 TRAFFIC ADVISORY 🚨

In view of the Hon’ble Prime Minister’s visit and Public Meeting at Parade Grounds, Secunderabad on 10.05.2026, traffic diversions and restrictions will be in force on roads leading towards the venue due to VVIP movement and large public gatherings.

⚠️ Traffic congestion is expected between 1:00 PM and 9:00 PM.

🔀 Major Traffic Diversions:

➡️ Begumpet <-> Sangeeth via Paradise–Patny–Clock Tower
➡️ Begumpet <-> Trimulgherry via St. John’s–AOC–KV
➡️ Balanagar <-> Secunderabad via Ameerpet–Panjagutta–Begumpet
➡️ Secunderabad <-> Bowenpally via Patny–Paradise–CTO
➡️ Tank Bund <-> Trimulgherry via Tadbund–Diamond Point

✅ Citizens are advised to:
🚇 Prefer Metro Rail & Public Transport
🛣️ Use alternate routes and plan travel in advance
🚫 Avoid roadside parking near event routes
👮 Follow traffic diversions and police instructions
🅿️ 12 designated parking areas have been arranged for public convenience. QR-code based navigation support will be available to guide commuters to parking locations.

📞 Traffic Helpline: 8712662999

Malkajgiri Traffic Police requests all citizens to cooperate for smooth traffic management and public safety.
